section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that Israel being called "sanctifiers of Your Name" relates to self-sacrifice for sanctification of God's Name, and that the two interpretations of "yikdishu et shimcha" are connected because drawing from the level of "Atah Kadosh" requires absolute self-nullification, which is achieved through self-sacrifice.
section.t: And it continues in the maamar
(of Yud-Beis Kislev),
that this that Israel is called by the name "sanctifiers of Your Name" also relates to the fact that Israel give over their souls for the sanctification of the Name.
And so it is also in the aforementioned maamar of the Baal HaHilula, that the matter of "yikdishu et shimcha" is self-sacrifice for the sanctification of the Name.
And it can be said,
that the connection of the two interpretations of "yikdishu et shimcha"—
self-sacrifice for the sanctification of the Name and the drawing down of "Atah Kadosh" into "Shimcha Kadosh"—
is,
that in order to reach and draw down from the level of "Atah Kadosh"
(which is above the category of concealment and revelation)
there must be ultimate self-nullification,
and self-sacrifice is ultimate self-nullification.
And it can be said,
that this is also the reason that the matter of self-sacrifice is called by the name "sanctification of the Name,"
because through self-sacrifice they draw down into the Name from the holiness of the Awtsmoos.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the two aspects of the drawing down in "yikdishu et shimcha" have parallels in the service of self-sacrifice, where the drawing of the Awtsmoos comes through nullification and the revelation within the Name comes through the Yechidah being revealed, and that remembering self-sacrifice brings this revelation into all particular levels, even into the physical world.
section.t: And according to the known principle
that the service of man through which the drawing down is effected must be similar to the drawing down,
it can be said,
that the two matters in the drawing down of "yikdishu et shimcha"—the drawing down from "Atah Kadosh" into "Shimcha Kadosh,"
and that through this there is also made in the Name a matter of revelation—have their parallel in the service of self-sacrifice.
For the drawing down of the Awtsmoos is through the nullification of self-sacrifice
(as above),
and that which is made in the Name
(the concealment)
a matter of revelation is through the fact that in self-sacrifice the Yechidah
(the concealment that is above revelation)
comes into revelation.
And according to what is explained in Tanya
that the fulfillment of Torah and its mitzvos depends on this, that one always remember the matter of giving over his soul to God,
it can be said,
that through remembering the matter of self-sacrifice,
the revelation of the Yechidah is
(also)
in the particular levels within man
[for through remembering the matter of self-sacrifice there is an increase and addition in the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos],
and through this also the revelation that is made in the Name is not only a revelation in generality but also in the particular levels,
beginning from the four levels in the prayer "Atah Echad" as explained at length in the aforementioned maamar of the Baal HaHilula,
until the revelation will be even below in this physical world,
"And every worker shall know that You are its Maker,"
and in this world itself—in its lowest aspect,
"And all flesh shall see together that the mouth of God has spoken,"
that even the flesh
(not only the eyes of flesh but also the flesh itself)
will see that its entire existence is the word of God that brings it into being every moment from nothing to something.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section concludes that similarly regarding Israel, through whom this revelation is made, the revelation of the essence of the soul will be drawn into the particular levels of the soul, until the revelation of the essence of the soul as it is rooted in the Awtsmoos—Israel and the King alone together.
section.t: And likewise regarding Israel
(through whom this revelation is made),
that even in the particular levels of the soul the revelation of the essence of the soul will be drawn,
until the revelation of the essence of the soul as it is rooted in the Awtsmoos,
Israel and the King alone together.
